description: This file defines functions, classes, and types related to managing agent directories in a configuration context, including detecting duplicate agent directories and formatting related error messages.

classes.name: DuplicateAgentDir
classes.description: Represents a set of agent IDs sharing the same directory path.

classes.name: DuplicateAgentDirError
classes.description: Custom error class for reporting duplicate agent directories.

methods.name: canonicalizeAgentDir
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes an agent directory path, considering platform-specific case sensitivity.

methods.name: collectReferencedAgentIds
methods.description: Collects all agent IDs referenced in the configuration, including defaults and bindings.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveAgentDir
methods.description: Resolves the effective directory for a given agent ID, considering configuration and environment.

methods.name: findDuplicateAgentDirs
methods.description: Finds and returns all duplicate agent directories based on configuration.

methods.name: formatDuplicateAgentDirError
methods.description: Formats an error message listing duplicate agent directories.
